export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/maahir-foods) header states "Total Shipments 379 Records detected", "Trading Partners 10", "Ports 28", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-23". Rows actually seen on the free view: 5 shipment rows (counter says 379, rows seen = 5). Exact evidence line: "2026-02-23 | MAAHIR FOODS | MY002 | DEHYDRATED WHITE ONION POWDER (AS PER INVPKG)- PIPAVAV VICTOR PORT GUJARAT SEA INPAV1, India | Port Kelang, MALAYSIA | 07122000 | 9939791". Other rows seen: 2026-02-20 Valencia, SPAIN, HS 07122000, BOL 9870777; 2026-02-13 Hamburg, GERMANY, HS 07122000, BOL 9657449; 2026-02-06 Jakarta, Indonesia, HS 07122000, BOL 9449168; 2026-02-05 Antwerpen, BELGIUM, HS 07122000, BOL 9416741. Buyer-side counterparties listed include "TO ORDER SA001 MAAHIR FOODS, CAP TOWN, 7945, SOUTH AFRICA" (22 shipments), "TO ORDER USA002 MAAHIR FOODS, ILLINOIS, USA" (19), "TO ORDER SL MAAHIR FOODS ... INDONESIA" (14). Registered address shown: "RS NO 468P2 VILLAGE BHADROD".
note: Export side is factually confirmed: real sea shipments of dehydrated onion/shallot products under HS 07122000 from Pipavav (Gujarat) to Malaysia, Spain, Germany, Indonesia and Belgium, with dated customs records and BOL numbers, latest 2026-02-23. Declared HS 071220 matches the actual code 07122000 seen in every row, so no HS correction is needed. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could NOT be checked: the web_search tool returned connection errors on all three attempts and volza returned HTTP 403, so no domestic record was retrieved — recorded as unknown/null rather than guessed. Note the entity appears to be a partnership/proprietorship-style name (address "RS NO 468P2 VILLAGE BHADROD", no CIN found); the separate slug 'maahir-foods-pvt-ltd' returned an empty record set, so the 379 shipments belong to the exact-name entity 'MAAHIR FOODS', not to a Pvt Ltd variant. Revenue and export value figures are not public on the free views — left null, not estimated. Role appears to be manufacturer-exporter of dehydrated onion (own product grades, own packing), but that is inferred from product descriptions, not from a registry.
